artifact: gen_art_evaluation_1 :: does the paraphrase axis really read refusal?
scope: Pure re-analysis of archived iteration-1/2 artifacts plus a forward-pass-only re-encode of already-logged text. No new sampling, no new steered generation, no training.

decision_constants.multiplicity: Holm across the 6 depth-panel checkpoints, reported alongside CIs

analysis_1_heldout_certification.pool: AB-BLIND POOL: model-generated text that neither axis A nor axis B was fitted on and that neither A nor B steering produced. Sources: (S1) EXP1 unsteered benchmark generations bench_*.jsonl; (S2) EXP1 steered generations along axes C_stylistic / D_random* / E_prompt_contrast at any alpha, plus any-axis rows at alpha <= 0.10; (S3) the iteration-1 behavioural archive for the 0.6B lineage; (S4) EXP2 breadth-panel behaviour_* generations for the matching lineage.
analysis_1_heldout_certification.why_ab_blind: Refusals induced by steering ALONG axis A would inflate AUROC(A) by construction. Excluding A- and B-steered text above alpha 0.10 removes that circularity; the remaining steering axes have |cos| <= 0.10 with both A and B.
analysis_1_heldout_certification.confound_control: Steering axis Y at coefficient alpha adds alpha*NORM_L*cos(X,Y) to every projection s_X within that stratum, identically for refusals and compliances. PRIMARY projections are therefore CENTRED WITHIN (source-stratum) before pooling, which removes the additive shift exactly. Raw (uncentred) projections ship as a secondary column.

position_convention.primary: residual state at the FIRST GENERATED token position, layer L
position_convention.secondary: mean over all generated-token positions, layer L (the convention the axes were fitted under)

labels.primary: SEMANTIC judge label where the archive already carries one, otherwise the anchored refusal-onset regex from EXP1 classify.py
labels.secondary: regex-only column, shipped for every cell
labels.agreement: Cohen's kappa(regex, judge) on the overlap, per checkpoint

exclusions_stated_in_advance: fluent == false (EXP1 fluency screen) where the archive records it
any item whose text exactly matches an axis fit response (leakage gate V1)
statistics: AUROC(refusal vs compliance) per checkpoint x axis, cluster bootstrap CI
Cohen's d and raw mean difference in projection units
PAIRED AUROC(A) - AUROC(B) on the same items with cluster bootstrap CI and bootstrap p (this is the statistic the verdict keys on)
residual test: regress s_B on s_A, report R^2 and the AUROC of the residual

verdict_rule.counting_universe: POWERED checkpoints only: a checkpoint enters the count iff it has >= 40 items in EACH class. Checkpoints below that are reported as UNDERPOWERED and excluded, with the exclusion listed. The rule fires on a MAJORITY of powered checkpoints and requires >= 3 powered checkpoints; with fewer than 3 the verdict is BLOCKED_UNDERPOWERED.
verdict_rule.LEXICALITY_CONFIRMED: On a majority of powered checkpoints the paired AUROC(A) - AUROC(B) has an upper 95% CI bound <= 0.10 (B is not materially worse than A), AND on a majority of powered checkpoints the AUROC CIs of C_stylistic and D_random0 overlap the chance band [0.40, 0.60]. Reading: axis B IS a refusal direction -- it reads real refusals -- and yet never induces refusal. That is a wording-vs-behaviour dissociation and is the paper's headline.
verdict_rule.DOWNGRADE_TO_AXIS_ESTIMATION_FRAGILITY: On a majority of powered checkpoints AUROC(A) - AUROC(B) exceeds 0.10 with a CI excluding 0. Reading: B is a weaker/noisier estimate of the same direction; the headline becomes axis-estimation fragility and the paper must say so in those words.
verdict_rule.MIXED: Neither rule fires. Report per-checkpoint and name which fall each way.
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: Axis reproduction gate (V2) fails, or fewer than 3 powered checkpoints.

analysis_2_contrast_units.steering_convention: To be extracted from EXP1 models.make_steer_hook and recorded verbatim in eval_out.json.metadata.steering_convention -- not assumed.
analysis_2_contrast_units.contrast_unit: c = alpha * NORM_L / raw_norm_X (X's own diff-in-means norm)

matched_contrast_verdict.NORM_MISMATCH_DOES_NOT_EXPLAIN: at matched contrast units B's refusal rate stays materially below A's (paired difference CI excludes 0 in A's favour) on a majority of checkpoints
matched_contrast_verdict.MAGNITUDE_ARTIFACT: B catches up at matched contrast units (paired difference CI covers 0 or favours B) on a majority of checkpoints

analysis_2_contrast_units.degeneracy_threat: If B's refusal-rate ceiling coincides with its fluency collapse, that is an alternative explanation for B never crossing 0.5 and MUST be reported as a threat with the collapse alpha named.

analysis_3_semantic_dose.cache_first: resolve every candidate against existing judge caches (EXP1 results/judge.json items, EXP2 judge_cache.jsonl, iteration-1 caches) before paying for any call
analysis_3_semantic_dose.rubric: EXP2 lib/judge.py verbatim: REFUSAL / PARTIAL / COMPLIANCE / DEGENERATE
analysis_3_semantic_dose.reversal_rule: If B's judge-scored refusal rate is materially higher than its regex rate -- i.e. B WAS inducing refusals the regex missed -- that PARTLY REVERSES the headline and is reported as a reversal, not as a footnote.
analysis_3_semantic_dose.attenuation: report an attenuation-corrected variant using the audited confusion matrix (per-class kappa for REFUSAL is only 0.391)

analysis_4_b_text.note: REFUSAL_NONCANONICAL is an explicit judge output class, not an inference; >= 20 boundary examples published verbatim.

validity_gates.V1: leakage: 0 held-out items overlap any axis fit response (exact string)
validity_gates.V2: axis reproduction: |re-derived raw_norm - stored|/stored < 1e-3 and |cosine difference| < 1e-3, per checkpoint per axis
validity_gates.V3: observable reproduction: re-encoded r_t at the last prompt token of unsteered rows reproduces the logged r_t_first (Pearson r >= 0.95); companion: correlation of the axis-A projection with logged r_t_first. NOTE stated in advance: r_t is a REFUSAL-TOKEN LOGIT MARGIN, not an axis projection, so the companion correlation is construct validity, not identity.
validity_gates.V4: power: n per class per checkpoint; < 40 => UNDERPOWERED, excluded from the verdict count
validity_gates.V5: Holm across the 6 checkpoints for the paired AUROC difference
validity_gates.V6: sign discipline: sign-oriented primary alongside the raw form
validity_gates.V7: one-sentence accounting of scanned / harvested / excluded items
validity_gates.V8: every headline number carries a JSON pointer into an archived file

failure_modes.F1: axes cannot be re-derived -> headline negative; Analysis 1 BLOCKED
failure_modes.F2: too few refusals -> UNDERPOWERED, do not relax the alpha ceiling silently
failure_modes.F3: cost cap -> Analysis 3 PARTIAL with the covered strata named
failure_modes.F5: MIXED verdict is a reportable outcome, not a failure

amendments.when_decided: 2026-08-12T22:05Z, after the item harvest and BEFORE any AUROC was computed
amendments.change: The verdict is counted over POWERED checkpoints (majority of powered, floor of 3 powered), not '>= 4 of 6'.
amendments.why: Base and abliterated members refuse rarely by construction; a fixed 4-of-6 rule would make the verdict MIXED by arithmetic rather than by evidence. The counting universe is stated before any AUROC exists.

amendments.when_decided: 2026-08-12T22:04Z, at the first axis re-derivation, before any analysis
amendments.data_state_at_decision: axis reproduction deviations for instruct_0p6 only
amendments.change: The V2 gate is reported at BOTH the pre-registered 1e-3 tolerance and a determinism-calibrated tolerance; every axis is re-derived TWICE on the same GPU so the bf16 non-determinism floor is measured rather than assumed.
amendments.why: F1 in the plan requires exactly this diagnostic. Re-derived norms land at 1e-3 to 3e-3 relative, and the cosines the archive stores reproduce to ~1e-4, so the question is whether the residual is nondeterminism. Both readings ship; nothing is silently relaxed.

amendments.when_decided: 2026-08-12T22:19Z, after the Analysis-3 judge labels were returned
amendments.data_state_at_decision: judge dose curves for all axes including the C/D controls
amendments.change: Analysis 3 gains a NULL-AXIS FLOOR column and a cross-rubric adjudication of the reversal (four-class vs five-class rubric on the same alpha region).
amendments.why: The norm-matched stylistic axis and the random axis induce 0.00 refusal under the regex, yet receive judge REFUSAL rates of 0.13-0.53 at their top alphas. That is a false-positive floor at degraded text, and a reversal claim has to clear it. The adjudication is reported as its own verdict field; the original pre-registered semantic verdict is retained unchanged beside it.
